The divisibility check and the 24:00 → 00:00 wrap are correct. The switch to banker's rounding is not.

The docstring says halfway times round up to the later boundary, and `test_halfway_rounds_up` (08:45 with 30-minute slots → 09:00) agrees. But `test_morning_standup_half_hour_slot` expects 09:15 with 30-minute slots → 09:00, which is also a halfway case and rounds down. The two tests contradict each other. The PR hides this by using round-half-to-even, which passes both only because of these particular inputs (index 17.5 → 18 and 18.5 → 18). It also changes documented behavior in other cases: 09:45 with 30-minute slots now gives 09:30 instead of 10:00, and the docstring still says "rounds up." There is no PR description flagging any of this.

Please keep the divisibility check and the wrap, keep round-half-up as documented, and take the conflicting standup test back to the teammate and the workplace team to resolve. Don't pick a rounding rule just to make the tests pass.
